title: Technology Sector Update for 08/01/2018: IQ,ZEN,ENPH,AAPL
text:

Technology stocks were firming in recent trading early Wednesday, including a nearly 5% gain for Apple after the tech giant breezed past analyst estimates with its latest quarterly results. Apple reported Q3 sales of $53.26 billion, up year-over-year from $45.4 billion and ahead of the analyst consensus of $52.4 billion. It posted EPS of $2.34, up from $1.67 a year ago and topping estimates of $2.18 per share.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
+ iQIYI, Inc. ( IQ ) was nudging higher in Wednesday's early session, climbing over 2%, after late Tuesday reporting a smaller Q2 net loss compared with the year-ago period following a 51% year-over-year increase in revenue for the Chinese online entertainment platform. iQIYI reported a net loss of RMB0.43 per share net loss during the three months ended June 30 after posting a net loss of RMB4.89 per share during the same quarter last year. Revenue rose to RMB6.17 billion - or about $932.5 million - from RMB4.33 billion last year.
In other sector news:
+ Zendesk ( ZEN ) climbed almost 8% in after-hours trading Tuesday night after the software development company reported above-consensus Q2 financial results and issued Q3 and FY18 revenue guidance also exceeding Street views. Excluding one-time items, Zendesk swung to a $0.03 per share non-GAAP profit compared with a $0.02 per share net loss during the year-ago period and beating the Capital IQ consensus expecting $0.00 per share for the April-to-June reporting period. Revenue rose year over year to $141.9 million from $102.1 million, also topping the $137.5 million Street view.
- Enphase Energy ( ENPH ) fell over 9% in Wednesday's early session after the electronic components company reported mixed Q2 financial results, including an increase in revenue during the April-to-June period to $75.9 million from $74.7 million last year, trailing the Capital IQ consensus of $76.8 million. It also forecast Q3 revenue lagging analyst estimates, although the company swung to a Q2 profit of $0.02 per share compared with an $0.08 per share net loss in the year-ago period and beating the Street view by $0.01 per share.
